articles.title: TRANSFORM A QUICK DRAWING INTO A LIVE APP WITH GEMINI
articles.summary: A photo of a paper sketch, from an app mock-up to a habit tracker or game board, can become a working app in Gemini. In the Canvas tool, Gemini reads the drawing, writes the code, and adjusts colors, fonts, or features in a live preview.

articles.title: GITHUB PREVIEWS A REDESIGNED PULL REQUEST OVERVIEW
articles.summary: GitHub's redesigned pull request Overview page began rolling out on November 5 as an opt-in public preview. A compact summary at the top now shows merge readiness, what is blocking it, and available actions, alongside new comment filters. Users can return to the classic view from the same menu. GitHub calls this an early iteration rather than the finished redesign.

articles.title: APPLE AIMING TO MAKE SIRI ‘MORE LIKE AN AGENT' AS SOON AS NEXT YEAR: REPORT
articles.summary: Apple is reportedly working to transform Siri into a proactive AI agent capable of tracking goals, planning next steps, and completing tasks without requiring users to initiate every action. The company could introduce these capabilities as early as 2027, building on the personalized Siri features delivered with iOS 27 and potentially using its App Intents framework to interact with applications more efficiently. Apple is also adjusting its iOS 28 development process to give engineers more time for coding and experimentation, reflecting the growing influence of AI-assisted development.

articles.title: RAISING THE CEILING MUST BE EARNED
articles.summary: AI tools can raise the baseline quality of creative work, but access to powerful technology does not automatically increase someone's ability to produce exceptional results. Developing taste and judgment requires understanding design fundamentals, recognizing weaknesses in generated work, and knowing how to direct improvements rather than accepting whatever looks convincing. AI-assisted prototyping can accelerate learning, but raising the ceiling of what's possible still depends on practicing the craft, understanding how things work, and developing the ability to critique them.

articles.title: NO FIGMA, ONE BRANCH, A 3-4 DAY SPRINT, AND WHERE THE ENGINEERS TAKE OVER
articles.summary: Design engineers can shorten the distance between design and development by creating functional prototypes directly in a product's codebase instead of producing static Figma handoffs. In one team's workflow, a design engineer collaborates on discovery, builds and tests prototypes with users in three to four days, and delivers finished components with Storybook documentation while software engineers handle backend systems and architecture. The role combines front-end development, rapid prototyping, user research, and AI-assisted coding, allowing designers to contribute directly to production without replacing specialized engineering expertise.

articles.title: WHY I MAKE MOOD BOARDS
articles.summary: Mood boards can become more than collections of visual references when the arrangement of images creates meanings that none of the individual pictures communicate alone. Juxtaposition, proximity, and contrast generate unexpected relationships between otherwise unrelated subjects, turning the act of collecting and arranging images into a form of visual thinking. Building collections gradually around themes such as machines, time, or technology allows new connections to emerge through experimentation rather than following a predetermined narrative.

articles.title: BUILD A POLISHED WEBSITE OR WEB APP WITH AI
articles.summary: Modulify turns your prompt into a polished landing page, website, dashboard, or app, ready to edit, refine, and launch.

articles.title: YOUR MARKETING STACK, CONNECTED TO YOUR AI
articles.summary: Orphex is the unified MCP gateway for digital marketing teams, handling auth and integrations for 50+ platforms, from Google Ads to Shopify, to give your AI true cross-channel context.

articles.title: THE BRAND LAYER FOR AGENTS
articles.summary: Rainbrand builds and maintains your brands' identity, guidance, and assets as shared context for AI agents and products.

articles.title: THERE'S NO BETTER NAME FOR DESIGN SYSTEMS
articles.summary: No better name for design systems exists, because what matters to stakeholders is what the system enables, not the components inside it. Product, methodology, and infrastructure each translate it for different audiences, with infrastructure traveling furthest across functions. Success means every team knows what the design system does for them, so it becomes simply the way things get built.

articles.title: WHAT GREATER DEVOLUTION COULD MEAN FOR DESIGN
articles.summary: Greater financial autonomy for regional governments in the UK could create new opportunities for design-led regeneration, with mayors gaining additional control over business rates, borrowing, and future income tax revenues. More predictable funding could encourage long-term investment in workplaces, infrastructure, and adaptive reuse projects that preserve local character while reducing construction waste and embodied carbon. Successful regeneration will depend on combining regional knowledge with broader design expertise, improving collaboration between public and private sectors, and creating spaces that reflect the communities and businesses they serve.

articles.title: THE VOLLEYBALL WORLD CUP LOGO LOOKS... WRONG
articles.summary: The identity for the 2027 FIVB Men's Volleyball World Cup in Poland features an abstract white emblem inspired by the tournament trophy, surrounded by concentric red circles. Its design combines several symbolic references, including the trophy's silhouette, the Earth, a volleyball net, players reaching for a ball, and fans represented by a wave at the base. Although these elements are individually identifiable, their combination produces an ambiguous mark that raises questions about how much symbolism a logo can communicate before losing immediate visual clarity.

articles.title: CÉSAR CID TURNS FAMOUS ARTISTS INTO LETTERS IN HIS PLAYFUL ALPHABET SERIES
articles.summary: The Artphabet turns 26 famous artworks into 3D letters, from a Warhol soup can shaped like an A to Munch's The Scream bent into a Z.

articles.title: E.L.F.'S STOP-MOTION CHRISTMAS AD IS A WIN FOR HUMAN CREATIVITY
articles.summary: e.l.f.'s first-ever holiday campaign is a stop-motion film built entirely by hand and narrated by Alan Cumming.

articles.title: APPLE MIGHT BE GETTING RID OF THE IPHONE'S ACTION BUTTON ALREADY
articles.summary: Apple may remove the dedicated Action button from its 2027 iPhone lineup, merging its functionality with the existing Camera Control button as part of a broader redesign.
